newsitem.title: CHINA: China stocks newspaper urges study of Deng theory.
newsitem.headline: China stocks newspaper urges study of Deng theory.

text.p: China's leading securities newspaper on Wednesday carried a front-page report on the economic theory of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, apparently part of efforts to cool market fears about his health.
China's state-run media made no mention in its reports on the sharp stock market falls on Tuesday of the main factor pushing prices down -- speculation that Deng's health may be deteriorating.

But the China Securities featured a box on its front page, highlighting to its readers, who include most of China's securities traders, a meeting in Beijing on Tuesday to study Deng's economic theories.
The rumours about Deng's health on Tuesday sent Shanghai's A share index plunging 8.97 percent to 932.783 points. The B share index lost 6.97 percent to 63.455 points.
In Shenzhen, the B share index lost 9.58 percent to 137.72 points and the A index slid 9.76 percent to 337.6 points.
Both markets recovered some ground early on Wednesday, but traders remained cautious.
Chinese sources told Reuters on Monday that Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin and Premier Li Peng had both cut short out-of-town trips last weekend to return to Beijing to visit Deng.
China's Foreign Ministry said on Tuesday there had been no major change in the health of the 92-year-old Deng but declined to elaborate.
